headline: Per-share earnings drop sharply from last quarter
summary_short: EPS was INR 1.78, down 49.3% from INR 3.51 in the prior quarter and down 22.6% from INR 2.30 a year earlier.
summary_long: Only the per-share earnings figure is available on the shard. It roughly halved q/q and fell 22.6% y/y. No revenue, margin or cash figures were available from the shard, and no drivers or guidance are assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Two web searches found no September-quarter 2026 release (June-quarter net profit of about INR 348 crore was the latest found). The shard report date falls on a Saturday and the EPS drop is large, so the Yahoo figure should be treated as unconfirmed.
